description: A tab panel holds the content shown for a single tab.

tags.devx: - Must be rendered inside a `TabPanels`, itself inside a `TabGroup`.
tags.a11y:
- Exposes `role="tabpanel"`, an `id`/`aria-labelledby` pair matching the
  connected `Tab`, and `tabIndex={0}` so keyboard users can move focus
  into the panel content.
tags.limitations:
- Unmounts when it stops being the active panel; scroll position, form
  input, and focus inside it are not preserved across a switch.

className.name: className
className.description: Root classes (string), static element classes (object), or state-aware element classes (function).

index.name: index
index.description: Injected by the parent TabPanels: position of this panel in the list.

tabsId.name: tabsId
tabsId.description: Injected by the parent TabPanels: identifier shared by every tab and panel of the group.

tags.devx: - Must be rendered inside a `udx-tab-panels`, itself inside a `udx-tab-group`.
tags.a11y:
- Exposes `role="tabpanel"`, an `id`/`aria-labelledby` pair matching the
  connected `udx-tab`, and `tabIndex={0}` while active so keyboard users
  can move focus into the panel content.
tags.limitations:
- Unlike React, scroll position and focus inside an inactive panel are
  preserved (its component instance stays alive, only hidden) -- do not
  rely on either behavior for cross-framework parity.

hostClass.name: hostClass
hostClass.description: Classes applied to the root element. Angular's native `class` attribute and `[class]` binding land here, merged with the component's own classes.

classes.name: classes
classes.description: Static or state-aware classes for the component's internal elements, keyed by element name.
